name: Basic Hotel
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Basic Hotel in Innsbruck is a hotel accommodation in the category of Hotel. It is centrally located in the capital city of the Austrian state of Tirol. The rooms are functional and well-equipped. The hotel provides basic services for its guests. Right nearby, visitors can find attractions such as the historic Altstadt and the Nordkette mountain range. Guests can explore the city and the surrounding alpine scenery. This hotel is ideal for travelers seeking a straightforward overnight stay.
